narrative:
COGS planning models EUR 1527.3M of cost of goods. Budget gross margin is 50.6%.

Operations Cast Labour is the largest cost line at 64% of COGS, driven by cast hours = demand (visits, occupied rooms, covers) ÷ productivity standard × cost per hour (35h rules, sunday/night premiums, social charges). Cost drivers are linked to the volume forecast so they flex with the revenue plan.

signals.title: Resort Hotels RevPAR EUR 3.3 below forecast — occupancy, not ADR
signals.source: SDP Hotel Revenue — 7 hotels, occupancy × ADR, booking-curve pace
signals.excerpt: October 2026 RevPAR was EUR 325.6 against EUR 328.9 forecast. ADR held at EUR 369 (+EUR 6 vs forecast), but occupancy was 88.2% against 90.5%: Davy Crockett Ranch (−EUR 16.6 RevPAR) and Hotel Santa Fe (−EUR 15.0) ran 6–7 points behind on weaker UK package pickup.

signals.title: UK & Ireland visits 8.8% below budget on GBP/EUR — offset by French domestic and Annual Pass growth
signals.source: SDP Guest Market Mix — booking source × country of residence × FX
signals.excerpt: UK & Ireland visits are 8.8% below budget since June as GBP/EUR moved from 0.84 to 0.88 and package prices rose for UK guests. French domestic visits are 4.9% above budget and Annual Pass visits about 9% up, recovering most of the admissions gap but with lower hotel attach.
